end_to_end.expected: Each hand's review tags exactly the decisions where Hint was opened before acting, including open-then-hide and open-hide-open, and matches the stored record's hinted flags. Hinted Major errors still show the grade. Tagged river entries with 5 cards stay inside the 400 px panel with no overflow.
end_to_end.actual: Up to 12 hands per run with mixed plans: Hint at every decision, open-then-hide at odd decisions, Hint at turn and river only, and open-hide-open at the first decision, plus river folds. In every hand the per-entry tags equalled both the hints I made and the stored hinted flags, and every grade was Correct, Minor error or Major error and visible. The tag always came after the grade, and grade and tag lay inside the entry and the panel. Panel and top row had scrollWidth <= clientWidth. Each run had 5 to 11 tagged 5-card river entries and 7 to 16 tagged Major errors. axe found no serious or critical issues. 4 of 4 runs passed. One earlier WebKit run stopped because the user went bust at random seed, which is not a product issue; I added a stop for that case.
